opus.problem: The rainbow detail is not in Genesis 9:15; it comes from the nearby verses (9:13-14, 16). The clue adds content its cited verse does not hold.
Genesis 9:28 gives only the 350 years. Dying at 950 is in Genesis 9:29, so the clue goes beyond its cited verse.
Eating, drinking and marrying is in Matthew 24:38, not the cited Matthew 24:39.
Forty days of rising water lifting Noah's ark gives the answer away on its own, so the clue is not medium hard.
A rainbow promise to Noah that this will never again destroy all life gives the answer away on its own, so the clue is not medium hard.
Six of the seven clues name Noah, which points almost straight to the flood. The set leans too easy; some clues should give the setting in a less direct way.
